Changed src/libraries/System.IO.FileSystem.Watcher/src/System/IO/FileSystemWatcher.cs and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/dotnet-handoff-watcher-buffer.md.

Commit message:
On the Tarnwick render farm a finished job renames 2,000-3,000 frame files within a second; an 8 KB buffer overflowed, the final names were missed and finished jobs were never picked up.

writes.docs/decisions/dotnet-handoff-watcher-bu:
# Why src/libraries/System.IO.FileSystem.Watcher/src/System/IO/FileSystemWatcher.cs holds this value

On the Tarnwick render farm a finished job renames 2,000-3,000 frame files within a second; an 8 KB buffer overflowed, the final names were missed and finished jobs were never picked up.
